data.name: game_collections_user_pgame_medium_unique_idx
data.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX game_collections_user_pgame_medium_unique_idx ON game_collections (user_id, platform_game_id, medium) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "games" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "subtitle" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "image" TEXT NULL, "thumbnail" TEXT NULL, "publish_year" INTEGER NULL, "min_players" INTEGER NULL, "max_players" INTEGER NULL, "playing_time" INTEGER NULL, "min_play_time" INTEGER NULL, "min_play_time_measure" TEXT NULL, "max_play_time" INTEGER NULL, "max_play_time_measure" TEXT NULL, "min_age" INTEGER NULL, "complexity" REAL NULL, "content_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'BaseGame', "total_play_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "average_rating" REAL NULL, "bayes_rating" REAL NULL, "ratings_count" INTEGER NULL, "owned_by_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "categories_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "mechanics_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "designers_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "publishers_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "tags_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "visibility" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Public', "created_by_id" TEXT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "full_record_cached_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "platform_games" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "game_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES games (id), "platform_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "platform_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "min_players" INTEGER NULL, "max_players" INTEGER NULL, "min_play_time" INTEGER NULL, "min_play_time_measure" TEXT NULL, "max_play_time" INTEGER NULL, "max_play_time_measure" TEXT NULL, "image" TEXT NULL, "thumbnail" TEXT NULL, "supports_solo" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("supports_solo" IN (0, 1)), "supports_local" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("supports_local" IN (0, 1)), "supports_online" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("supports_online" IN (0, 1)), "has_async_play" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("has_async_play" IN (0, 1)), "has_realtime" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("has_realtime" IN (0, 1)), "has_tutorial" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("has_tutorial" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "full_record_cached_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "game_collections" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "platform_game_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES platform_games (id), "medium" TEXT NOT NULL, "release_id" TEXT NULL, "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "rating" INTEGER NULL, "play_count" INTEGER NULL, "play_again" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("play_again" IN (0, 1)), "favorite" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("favorite" IN (0, 1)), "comment" TEXT NULL, "last_played" TEXT NULL, "last_updated" TEXT NULL, "is_dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_dirty" IN (0, 1)), "is_local_only" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_local_only" IN (0, 1)), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "households" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "image" TEXT NULL, "member_invite_policy" TEXT NULL, "is_dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_dirty" IN (0, 1)), "is_local_only" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_local_only" IN (0, 1)), "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "household_members" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES households (id), "show_all_games" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("show_all_games" IN (0, 1)), "role_name" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "household_moves" ("local_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("local_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_queue" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "retry_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_attempt_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "unsent_changes_users" ("user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recorded_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("user_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "game_access" ("user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "game_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES games (id), "source" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("user_id", "game_id", "source"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "platform_game_access" ("user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "platform_game_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES platform_games (id), "source" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("user_id", "platform_game_id", "source"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "household_id" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "image" TEXT NULL, "location" TEXT NULL, "url" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "reach" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "scheduling_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_dirty" IN (0, 1)), "is_local_only" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_local_only" IN (0, 1)), "generation" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_occurrences" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES events (id), "label" TEXT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, "location" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "confirmed_at" TEXT NULL, "declined_at" TEXT NULL, "cancelled_at" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_attendees" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES events (id), "user_id" TEXT NULL, "guest_name" TEXT NULL, "username" TEXT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NULL, "avatar_url" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "role_name" TEXT NULL, "rsvp_date" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_policies" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES events (id), "allow_member_invites" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("allow_member_invites" IN (0, 1)), "allow_guest_invites" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("allow_guest_invites" IN (0, 1)), "max_attendees" INTEGER NULL, "restrict_to_game_categories" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("restrict_to_game_categories" IN (0, 1)), "require_host_approval_to_join" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("require_host_approval_to_join" IN (0, 1)), "allow_spectators" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("allow_spectators" IN (0, 1)), "max_total_participants" INTEGER NULL, "strict_capacity" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("strict_capacity" IN (0, 1)), "game_addition_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "restrict_to_attendee_pool" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("restrict_to_attendee_pool" IN (0, 1)), "filler_max_play_time" INTEGER NULL, "vote_threshold_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "vote_threshold_value" INTEGER NULL, "vote_quorum_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "vote_quorum_value" INTEGER NULL, "vote_eligibility" TEXT NOT NULL, "interested_weight" TEXT NOT NULL, "voting_window_hours" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("event_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_access" ("user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES events (id), "source" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("user_id", "event_id", "source"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_generation" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_generation" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX platform_games_game_id_idx ON platform_games (game_id)
CREATE INDEX game_collections_user_idx ON game_collections (user_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX game_collections_user_pgame_medium_unique_idx ON game_collections (user_id, platform_game_id, medium) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX household_members_user_idx ON household_members (user_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX household_members_household_user_unique_idx ON household_members (household_id, user_id)
CREATE INDEX sync_queue_user_status_idx ON sync_queue (user_id, status, created_at)
CREATE INDEX game_access_game_id_idx ON game_access (game_id)
CREATE INDEX platform_game_access_platform_game_id_idx ON platform_game_access (platform_game_id)
CREATE INDEX event_occurrences_event_id_idx ON event_occurrences (event_id)
CREATE INDEX event_attendees_event_id_idx ON event_attendees (event_id)
CREATE INDEX event_attendees_user_id_idx ON event_attendees (user_id)
CREATE INDEX event_access_event_id_idx ON event_access (event_id)
